extracted.name: Beef Burgundy I
extracted.description: Succulent round steak is browned in olive oil, then simmered in beef broth and red wine. It’s seasoned with marjoram and thyme and accompanied with fresh sliced mushrooms and onions.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds round steak, cut into small pieces
instruction_lines: In a large stock pot over medium/high heat, heat the oil and add the beef pieces. Sprinkle the flour over the beef. Brown the meat on all sides.
Pour in broth and red wine. Sprinkle in salt, marjoram, thyme and black pepper.
Bring to a boil. Cover, and reduce heat. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender, stirring occasionally.
Add mushrooms and onions to the pot. Liquid should just cover everything. If necessary, add some more wine to cover. Cook until onions are limp.
